reason: I know we give away some free work, that's how we keep clients sweet, and I don't need an outside firm I've never heard of going through my PSA and contracts to tell me so. Nobody in my peer group has mentioned these people, so I'm not paying £240 a month on the strength of an ad.
objection: A brand-new company with no MSP owners vouching for it wants my full ticket history and client contracts, and half of what it 'finds' will be goodwill I chose to give or stuff my account managers already know about.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three owners in my peer group saying it found real money they actually billed without losing a client, with benchmark numbers to back it up.
